resources.string: Review your recorded symptoms day by day and compare cycles without guessing missing data.
Record a period start to begin your cycle review.
Recorded-day averages, 0–3. A dash means no records, not zero. Different recording coverage can affect comparisons.
Choose a symptom. Each tile shows cycle day and recorded intensity (0–3); tap any day to view or edit its entry. A dash means unrecorded.
These summaries describe your own entries, not a diagnosis or prediction. No symptom data is sent to ad services.
